decisions.reason: As a newly launched prescription product with its own product page, the vertigo combination tablet is likely to be given more time unless early demand proves clearly too weak.
The generic antidepressant fits a pharma manufacturer's core business, but generic price pressure and crowded competition make its near-term discontinuation risk somewhat higher.
A combination antihypertensive is a standard chronic-care product in the firm's main market and its dedicated page suggests an active commercial commitment.
The bone and joint dietary supplement appears less central to the firm's core pharmaceutical portfolio and had only limited website visibility, making withdrawal more likely if traction is modest.
